name: NTK — Near The Keyboard
note: build.mjs reads this file. Change a colour here, then run node build.mjs. The look: a keyboard as if Polestar had made it. Matte white surfaces with rounded corners and no outlines, thin dark seams between tiles, soft layered blurred shadows, dark glass for displays, and three accents: orange, brushed gold and black. A soft studio background, no grid. Light comes from above, behind and to the left, so shadows fall towards the front right.

studioEdge.use: backgrounds: the studio towards its edges

keyboard.note: Shared design values for the Android keyboard theme and the site, which are drawn in the same look: matte white tiles with rounded corners and no outlines, thin dark seams between them, soft blurred shadows, a dark display strip, orange for the Sign key, gold for one detail. What the app ships is in android/app/src/main/res/values{,-night}/colors-ntk.xml.
